calendarFaqs.q: What does “conference release” mean in District 279?
calendarFaqs.a: It means students do not attend school that day because conferences are scheduled. Families should check the separate elementary or secondary conference calendar for school and appointment details.

calendarFaqs.q: How does Osseo’s elementary six-day calendar work?
calendarFaqs.a: It is a numbered rotation used to align elementary physical education and music specialist schedules. It supplements the K–12 calendar and does not mean students attend six days per week.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Osseo Area Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for grades K–12 is Tuesday, September 8, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Osseo Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 24, 2026, through January 1, 2027. December 23 is already a no-student conference-release day, extending the practical student-free window.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Osseo Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. April 2 is also marked as a district-closed holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Are January 15 and April 23 no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: They are not holidays. Osseo labels both as student asynchronous remote-learning days while licensed staff complete instructional planning.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student contact days are in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists 172 contact days: 58 in trimester one, 58 in trimester two, and 56 in trimester three.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Osseo schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Thursday, June 10, 2027. Mark reporting follows June 11, and high-school commencement is June 13.

calendarFaqs.q: Which translated Osseo calendars are available?
calendarFaqs.a: Along with English, the district provides Hmong, Oromo, Russian, Spanish, Somali, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese K–12 PDFs for 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families find school-specific conference or orientation times?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Osseo calendars page for elementary and secondary conference calendars, open house and orientation schedules, and school-level events. The districtwide K–12 calendar does not include appointment times for every school.
